title: Revolutions during the 1820s
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Revolutions during the 1820s", at revision 1369393690, opens: "Revolutions during the 1820s included revolutions in Russia, Spain, Portugal, and the Italian states for constitutional monarchies, and for independence from Ottoman rule in Greece. Unlike the revolutionary wave in the 1830s, these tended to take place in the peripheries of Europe." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2289594, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "revolutions in Europe starting in 1820". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
